generation.prompt: Create one production logo asset sheet on a genuinely transparent background, not a mockup. TWO complete horizontal logo lockups stacked vertically with a very large EMPTY TRANSPARENT gap between them. No labels and no background panels. Both rows use exactly the same spelling, proportions, layout, and motif. Each row: a separate bold compact emblem on the far left, then a generous transparent horizontal gap, then the complete business name at right. The left emblem must remain unmistakable at 32 px. The complete name must be clean and legible at a small website-header size; use strong simple shapes and avoid tiny taglines. TOP ROW is the dark-ink version for WHITE backgrounds. BOTTOM ROW is the light-ink version for CHARCOAL or RED backgrounds: replace every dark text fill with solid white, preserving accent colours only where they remain readable. Use a thin contrasting keyline around coloured details so they remain visible on all backgrounds. Flat graphic design, crisp edges, no gradients, no shading, no texture, no shadow, no photography, no microtype. Real transparent alpha everywhere outside the actual shapes. Wide landscape canvas with equal row spacing and generous outer transparent margins. This is an independent dealer preview; no approval claims. Create a refined independent proposal for TOMLINSON CAR SALES. Compact left emblem is a bold interlocking TC monogram with a simple balanced circular aperture, without a surrounding badge. Deep navy and muted warm gold palette. At right TOMLINSON in substantial refined sans-serif capitals above CAR SALES, with restrained letter spacing. Keep every word large enough to read; no extra tagline. Top text navy, bottom text white; gold accent remains small and strong.
